# Property: LINE\_LOOP

```ts
readonly LINE_LOOP: LINE_LOOP;
```

Draw consecutive vertices as one connected closed loop.

Use this for orbit rings, cells, seals, and procedural outlines where
the last vertex should connect back to the first.
